title: [P0] Robust Last.fm response parsing
description: Parse both XML and JSON response structures from Last.fm, handle ignored scrobble error codes (e.g. code 3 timestamp too new), and trigger circuit breaker on 5 consecutive 5xx errors.
acceptance_criteria: Handles Last.fm response schemas; logs ignored scrobbles without aborting entire queue; circuit breaker triggers on persistent 5xx failures.
close_reason: Verified against codebase: src/lastfm_client.py XML/JSON parsing and circuit breaker pass unit tests

title: [P0] Last.fm session validation
description: Validate Last.fm user session key on startup and during continuous operation, back off gracefully on transient network errors, and halt engine on fatal auth failures.
acceptance_criteria: Session validated against Last.fm API on initialization; fatal auth errors halt engine without retrying indefinitely.
close_reason: Verified against codebase: src/lastfm_client.py session validation and auth backoff pass tests in tests/unit/test_lastfm.py

title: [P0] Quota Tracker correction
description: Correct the SQLite quota tracker to maintain a rolling 24-hour scrobble count, prevent race conditions with atomic transactions, and handle clock drift.
acceptance_criteria: Rolling 24h window accurately calculated; SQLite transactions atomic; thread-safe operations pass tests.
close_reason: Verified against codebase: src/quota_tracker.py rolling 24h window and transactions pass tests in tests/unit/test_quota_tracker.py

title: [P2.3C] YouTube provider contract tests
description: Add YouTube provider contract specification to tests/contracts/, validating url detection, canonical track normalization, error classification, health check, and offline purity against SourceClient interface contract.
acceptance_criteria: All contract test suites pass for YouTube provider along with Spotify and Fake provider.

title: [P2.3B] YouTubeAdapter implementation
description: Implement YouTubeAdapter conforming to SourceClient in src/sources/youtube_adapter.py and register with SourceFactory. Must support YouTube playlist/album/track URLs, map metadata to CanonicalTrack, and translate network/parsing failures to SourceError hierarchy.
acceptance_criteria: YouTubeAdapter implements supports_url, fetch_sources, and check_health; registers with SourceFactory; converts YouTube payloads to CanonicalTrack without breaking engine.

title: [P2.3A] YouTube technical feasibility investigation
description:
## Goal

Investigate technical feasibility for ingesting music metadata from YouTube and YouTube Music (playlists, albums, and videos). Evaluate YouTube Data API v3 quota cost vs unauthenticated embed/public page metadata extraction, rate limits, schema stability, duration parsing, and multi-artist resolution heuristics.

## Findings

Pending investigation execution during P2.3A.
acceptance_criteria: Architectural feasibility document produced evaluating retrieval strategies, rate limits, and failure modes; recommending concrete design for YouTubeAdapter.

title: [P1.2] Spotify ingestion migration
description: Migrate Spotify ingestion into SpotifyAdapter implementing SourceClient and wrap with SourceIngestionService while preserving 100% cache and metadata backward compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: SpotifyAdapter passes all contract tests; SourceIngestionService handles batch caching and fallbacks; engine migrated without breaking existing workflows.
close_reason: Verified against codebase: SpotifyAdapter and SourceIngestionService verified in tests/unit/test_source_migration.py

title: [P1.1] CanonicalTrack and SourceClient architecture
description: Introduce provider-independent CanonicalTrack data model and SourceClient abstract base class to decouple ScrobbleForge engine and queue manager from Spotify-specific data structures.
acceptance_criteria: CanonicalTrack supports artists, album, duration, ISRC, external_ids, and provider_id; SourceClient defines supports_url, fetch_sources, and check_health.
close_reason: Verified against codebase: CanonicalTrack in src/core/models.py and SourceClient in src/sources/base.py fully implemented and tested

title: [P2.4] Multi-provider cache and refresh hardening
description: Harden cache storage and periodic refresh orchestration when mixing multiple providers in MUSIC_SOURCES. Ensure transient failure on one provider during periodic refresh preserves healthy cache entries for unaffected providers.
acceptance_criteria: Independent provider cache isolation verified; partial refresh failure does not evict unaffected provider tracks from cache.

title: [P2.3D] YouTube configuration and documentation
description: Document YouTube source configuration in README.md and .env.example. Add any optional YouTube API credentials or settings to SourceConfig in src/config.py with validation tests.
acceptance_criteria: Configuration parses optional YouTube settings; README and .env.example clearly document usage; unit tests pass.

title: [P2.2] Multi-provider contract tests and reliability fixes
description: Build reusable provider contract test suite in tests/contracts/, isolate cross-provider track identity with provider_id prefixing in QueueManager, and fix structured HTTP status error classification (HTTP 429 rate limit, auth, timeouts).
acceptance_criteria: Contract test suite passes for fake provider and SpotifyAdapter; queue checkpoints isolated across providers; structured status codes preferred over string matching; 276 pytest tests pass.
close_reason: Verified against codebase: Contract test suite in tests/contracts/ (86 tests) and structured HTTP 429/auth classification verified; 276 pytest tests pass

title: [P2.1] Generic source configuration
description: Support generic MUSIC_SOURCES and SOURCES_REFRESH_INTERVAL_HOURS environment variables with precedence over legacy SPOTIFY_* configuration.
acceptance_criteria: AppConfig parses comma-separated MUSIC_SOURCES into SourceConfig; falls back to SPOTIFY_* when unset; precedence tests pass.
close_reason: Verified against codebase: SourceConfig in src/config.py verified in tests/unit/test_source_config.py

title: [P3.3] Web UI dashboard
description: Build a modern, responsive web dashboard interfacing with the local API to visualize active queue, recent scrobbles, 24-hour quota gauge, and manage playlist sources.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays live queue and quota metrics; enables adding/removing playlist sources.

title: [P3.2] Local API and source management
description: Expose lightweight localhost REST API service to monitor playback, inspect the active queue, and dynamically add or remove sources at runtime without restarting the daemon.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoints for GET /status, GET /queue, POST /sources implemented with local-only host binding.

title: [P3.1] CLI management improvements
description: Expand CLI to support operational commands: inspect configured sources, view current queue status, force cache refresh, and display rolling 24h quota stats.
acceptance_criteria: CLI commands support non-interactive query options and output structured or tabular status.

title: [P3.4] Desktop and system tray integration
description: Package ScrobbleForge with a background system tray utility for quick control (pause, resume, skip), desktop notifications on scrobble, and single-click access to the Web UI.
acceptance_criteria: System tray icon provides status indicators and menu actions; starts/stops daemon cleanly.
